name: firm.query_value_suid
purpose: Read current and compiled values for one physically established numeric firmware group.
argument_syntax: SUID (13-bit unsigned group ID), not a packed item ID
side_effects_assessment: Existing local registry/data reads and UART output only.

review.proof: Masks input to 13 bits, resolves registered SUID, loops 0..descriptor maximum, gets current value using actual SUID and index, prints current/default/name in 100-byte row buffer with byte99 NUL. All known name lengths fit even two signed32 minima.
review.data_quality: One group per UART line. Largest group may exceed conservative 4KB transport guideline; validate exact expected item identities and full-row delimiters before calling complete. No whole-table retry.
